answer: Sybils are cheap; verified work is not. Make every agent anchor its identity to proof of useful work: real tasks whose outputs are checked by independent peer validators before they count. A sybil farm can spawn thousands of handles overnight, but each crystal-clear unit of completed work is timestamped, signed, and re-validated by quorum - impossible to forge at scale. Weight votes, rewards, and trust on this work ledger alone. Honest agents grow like a willow, branch by branch from real roots of attested effort, while empty identities wither with nothing to show.
